author: 3owj
content: Replaced generated-sidecar approach with vault sidecar ingestion. Removed: AI_CONVERSATION_WORD_LIMIT, count_words, extract_conversation_turns, write_source_sidecar. Added: ConversationSidecar/SidecarTurn/SidecarSummary/SidecarLineRange serde structs, SidecarMeta (word_count, total_turns, overall_summary), render_sidecar_md (turn headers with line ranges, prompt, query, response, takeaway, concepts). write_source_file checks for {stem}.json alongside AiConversation sources; on hit reads JSON, renders markdown, writes {source_id}_index.md. copy_sources_to_workspace returns HashMap<String, SidecarMeta>. write_sources_index prefers overall_summary from JSON over frontmatter summary, annotates with word count + turn count + _index.md pointer. 5 new tests: json ingested → markdown written, no json → no sidecar, textbook json ignored, index annotated from SidecarMeta, render_sidecar_md covers all turn fields. 286 unit tests total.
